title: Corrected Calcium in Hypoalbuminemia
sources: Payne RB et al. Br Med J 1973

changelog.change: Initial entry. Stable formula — no scheduled review.

purpose: Estimates true calcium status when albumin is low — avoids missing or over-calling hypocalcemia. Ionized calcium is the definitive test when available.

interpretation.label: 8.5-10.5 mg/dL — corrected calcium within normal range

notes: Adds 0.8 mg/dL per 1 g/dL the albumin is below 4.0. The correction is an approximation and performs poorly in critical illness — obtain an ionized calcium when the result would change management.
